notes.title: Version 1.0.3
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, [/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed a few bugs
[*] Russian language is back
[*] Chinese language is under development
[/list]

[h3][b]If you have any problems or have noticed a bug, write in the discussions, I will help you,[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.content:
[b][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] The hospital's location environment has been slightly modified
[*] Added running at 2x speed
[*] Fixed bug with riddles (now ALT + TAB closes the riddle and control is not taken away)
[*] Added 1 secret achievement 
[/list]
